resolutions.researcher_notes: Value = operating. Both Argaam and Shorouk (independent Egyptian daily) report the petroleum sector completed (انتهاء/انتهى تنفيذ) the Nubaria–Sadat line, dated 2014-10-03; completed = operating. NOTE: brief marked the Argaam URL DEAD_LINK, but it now returns 200 and contains النوبارية (re-verified live), so it is retained and corroborated.

Value = 73 km. Argaam and Shorouk both state 'بطول 73 كم وقطر 36 بوصة' (73 km, 36-inch). CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: egy-map.com (Egypt's Projects Map, aggregator) reports 70 km — a minor rounding discrepancy from a weaker source; the two independent 73 km sources are preferred.

Values = Start El Noubareya (Alexandria/Beheira area) → End El Sadat (Sadat City, Monufia). Both sources describe the line running from النوبارية to السادات (Sadat City) and on to Dahshur, carrying gas from northern production fields (Burullus, Abu Qir) to power stations serving greater Cairo. Sadat City is in Monufia governorate; supports endpoint locations.

Value = 495,000,000 EGP. Argaam states the Nubaria–Sadat line was executed 'باستثمارات 495 مليون جنيه' (495 million EGP). Shorouk's headline figure of 590 million EGP is the COMBINED total for BOTH the Nubaria–Sadat AND the Edfu lines ('خطي غاز النوبارية–السادات وإدفو بـ590 مليون جنيه'); the 495M sheet value for this segment alone is consistent. egy-map reports 700M (weaker aggregator, not preferred).

Value = Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co (EGAS) 100%. EGAS official site confirms EGAS manages/holds the national natural gas network (الشبكة القومية للغازات الطبيعية) value chain, of which this trunk line is a part — consistent with GEM's owner attribution. CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: the two strong news sources (Argaam, Shorouk) name GASCO (جاسكو) as 'المشغل الرئيسي للشبكة القومية' — i.e. GASCO is the network OPERATOR, while EGAS is the state holding/owning entity. Owner=EGAS is defensible as the holding company but is not explicitly stated as owner of this specific line; operator would more precisely be GASCO. Tier low.
